sentence_examples.en: An Abstract Factory is a design pattern that provides an interface for creating families of related or dependent objects without specifying their concrete classes.
sentence_examples.zh: 抽象工厂是一种设计模式，提供用于创建相关或依赖对象族的接口，而无需指定其具体类。

sentence_examples.en: The software uses an Abstract Factory to generate UI components that adapt to different operating systems.
sentence_examples.zh: 该软件使用抽象工厂生成适应不同操作系统的用户界面组件。

sentence_examples.en: The Abstract Factory Pattern provides an interface for creating families of related or dependent objects without specifying their concrete classes.
sentence_examples.zh: 抽象工厂模式提供一个接口，用于创建相关或依赖对象的家族，而无需指定具体类。

sentence_examples.en: By using the Abstract Factory Pattern, developers can ensure that the created objects are compatible with each other.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过使用抽象工厂模式，开发者可以确保所创建的对象彼此兼容。

sentence_examples.en: An abstraction layer is a way of hiding the implementation details of a particular set of functionality.
sentence_examples.zh: 抽象层是一种隐藏特定功能实现细节的方法。

sentence_examples.en: The operating system uses an abstraction layer to manage hardware resources efficiently.
sentence_examples.zh: 操作系统通过抽象层高效管理硬件资源。

sentence_examples.en: Access refers to the ability to read, write, or use a system, data, or resource.
sentence_examples.zh: 访问指的是读取、写入或使用系统、数据或资源的能力。

sentence_examples.en: Users must authenticate before they can access the database.
sentence_examples.zh: 用户必须先通过身份验证才能访问数据库。

sentence_examples.en: An access modifier is a keyword in programming that sets the accessibility of classes, methods, and other members.
sentence_examples.zh: 访问修饰符是编程中的关键字，用于设定类、方法和其他成员的可访问性。

sentence_examples.en: Using the private access modifier restricts access to the class members only within the declared class.
sentence_examples.zh: 使用私有访问修饰符可将类成员的访问权限限制在声明该成员的类内部。

sentence_examples.en: An acoustic coupler is a device that converts digital data into sound signals for transmission over telephone lines.
sentence_examples.zh: 声耦合器是一种将数字数据转换为声音信号以通过电话线传输的设备。

sentence_examples.en: Early modems often used an acoustic coupler to connect to a telephone handset.
sentence_examples.zh: 早期的调制解调器通常使用声耦合器连接到电话听筒。

sentence_examples.en: Active Directory is a directory service developed by Microsoft for Windows domain networks to manage and organize resources.
sentence_examples.zh: Active Directory 是微软为 Windows 域网络开发的目录服务，用于管理和组织资源。

sentence_examples.en: Administrators use Active Directory to control access to network resources and enforce security policies.
sentence_examples.zh: 管理员使用 Active Directory 控制对网络资源的访问并执行安全策略。

sentence_examples.en: The Acyclic Dependencies Principle states that dependencies between packages or modules should not form cycles to ensure maintainable and modular software design.
sentence_examples.zh: 无环依赖原则规定，包或模块之间的依赖不应形成循环，以确保软件设计的可维护性和模块化。

sentence_examples.en: By adhering to the Acyclic Dependencies Principle, developers can avoid complex interdependencies that complicate testing and refactoring.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过遵循无环依赖原则，开发者可以避免复杂的相互依赖，从而简化测试和重构工作。

sentence_examples.en: An acyclic digraph is a directed graph with no directed cycles.
sentence_examples.zh: 无环有向图是一种不包含有向环的有向图。

sentence_examples.en: Algorithms for topological sorting often operate on acyclic digraphs.
sentence_examples.zh: 拓扑排序算法通常在无环有向图上运行。

sentence_examples.en: An adapter is a device or software component that allows incompatible systems to work together by converting data or signals from one format to another.
sentence_examples.zh: 适配器是一种设备或软件组件，通过将数据或信号从一种格式转换为另一种格式，使不兼容的系统能够协同工作。

sentence_examples.en: The USB-C adapter enabled the older laptop to connect to the new monitor seamlessly.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款USB-C适配器使旧笔记本电脑能够无缝连接到新显示器。

sentence_examples.en: The Adapter Pattern is a structural design pattern that allows incompatible interfaces to work together by converting the interface of one class into another expected by the clients.
sentence_examples.zh: 适配器模式是一种结构型设计模式，通过将一个类的接口转换为客户端期望的另一种接口，使不兼容的接口能够协同工作。

sentence_examples.en: By using the Adapter Pattern, developers can integrate legacy code with new systems without modifying the original classes.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过使用适配器模式，开发者可以在不修改原有类的情况下，将遗留代码与新系统集成。

sentence_examples.en: Adaptive code refers to software that can adjust its behavior or structure in response to changing conditions or requirements.
sentence_examples.zh: 自适应代码指的是能够根据变化的条件或需求调整其行为或结构的软件。

sentence_examples.en: The development team implemented adaptive code to ensure the application remains efficient under varying workloads.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发团队实现了自适应代码，以确保应用程序在不同工作负载下保持高效。

sentence_examples.en: To add a parameter in a function definition allows the function to accept additional inputs.
sentence_examples.zh: 在函数定义中添加参数可使函数接受额外的输入。

sentence_examples.en: The developer decided to add a parameter to handle optional configuration settings.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者决定添加一个参数来处理可选的配置设置。

sentence_examples.en: ADSL is a type of digital subscriber line technology that provides faster data transmission over copper telephone lines than a conventional voiceband modem can provide.
sentence_examples.zh: ADSL是一种数字用户线技术，能通过铜质电话线提供比传统语音频带调制解调器更快的数据传输。

sentence_examples.en: Many households use ADSL for high-speed internet access because it allows simultaneous voice and data communication.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多家庭使用ADSL进行高速互联网接入，因为它允许同时进行语音和数据通信。

sentence_examples.en: Affinity in computing refers to the preference of a process or thread to execute on a particular processor or core.
sentence_examples.zh: 在计算中，亲和性指进程或线程倾向于在特定处理器或核心上执行。

sentence_examples.en: The scheduler uses CPU affinity to improve performance by reducing cache misses.
sentence_examples.zh: 调度器通过CPU亲和性减少缓存未命中，从而提升性能。

sentence_examples.en: An affinity group is a collection of individuals linked by a common interest, purpose, or characteristic, often used in computing to optimize task scheduling.
sentence_examples.zh: 关联群体是指由共同兴趣、目的或特征连接的一组个体，常用于计算中优化任务调度。

sentence_examples.en: The system administrator configured the affinity group to ensure related processes run on the same CPU core.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统管理员配置了亲和群组，以确保相关进程在同一个CPU核心上运行。

sentence_examples.en: An agent is a software entity that performs tasks autonomously on behalf of a user or another program.
sentence_examples.zh: 智能体是一种能够自主执行任务以代表用户或其他程序的软件实体。

sentence_examples.en: The system uses multiple agents to distribute workload efficiently across servers.
sentence_examples.zh: 该系统使用多个智能体在服务器间高效分配工作负载。

sentence_examples.en: An agent-based interface is a user interface that employs autonomous software agents to assist users in completing tasks.
sentence_examples.zh: 代理界面是一种利用自主软件代理协助用户完成任务的用户界面。

sentence_examples.en: The new application features an agent-based interface that simplifies complex workflows.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款新应用采用了代理界面，简化了复杂的工作流程。

sentence_examples.en: An aggregate is a collection of items that are gathered together to form a total quantity.
sentence_examples.zh: 聚合体是指汇集在一起形成总量的多个项目。

sentence_examples.en: The system aggregates data from multiple sources to generate comprehensive reports.
sentence_examples.zh: 该系统从多个来源聚合数据以生成全面的报告。

sentence_examples.en: An aggregate root is a cluster of domain objects that can be treated as a single unit for data changes.
sentence_examples.zh: 聚合根是可作为数据变更单一单元处理的领域对象集群。

sentence_examples.en: The aggregate root ensures consistency boundaries by controlling access to all objects within the aggregate.
sentence_examples.zh: 聚合根通过控制对聚合内所有对象的访问来确保一致性边界。

sentence_examples.en: Agile is a set of principles for software development that emphasizes flexibility, collaboration, and customer feedback.
sentence_examples.zh: 敏捷是一套强调灵活性、协作和客户反馈的软件开发原则。

sentence_examples.en: The team adopted an Agile approach to quickly respond to changing requirements.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队采用敏捷方法以快速响应不断变化的需求。

sentence_examples.en: An agile practice is a specific technique or method used to implement agile principles in software development.
sentence_examples.zh: 敏捷实践是一种用于在软件开发中实施敏捷原则的具体技术或方法。

sentence_examples.en: Daily stand-up meetings are a common agile practice to improve team communication.
sentence_examples.zh: 每日站会是一种常见的敏捷实践，用于改善团队沟通。

sentence_examples.en: An agile process is a set of methodologies designed for iterative and incremental software development.
sentence_examples.zh: 敏捷流程是一套用于迭代和增量式软件开发的方法论。

sentence_examples.en: The team adopted an agile process to improve collaboration and deliver updates faster.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队采用了敏捷流程以增强协作并更快地交付更新。

sentence_examples.en: Agility in software development refers to the ability to rapidly and efficiently adapt to changes.
sentence_examples.zh: 软件开发中的敏捷性指的是快速高效地适应变化的能力。

sentence_examples.en: The team improved their agility by adopting iterative development practices.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队通过采用迭代开发实践提高了敏捷性。

sentence_examples.en: AI, or artificial intelligence, refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed to think and learn.
sentence_examples.zh: 人工智能（AI）指的是在机器中模拟人类智能，使其能够思考和学习。

sentence_examples.en: Many industries are now leveraging AI to automate complex tasks and improve efficiency.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多行业现在利用人工智能来自动化复杂任务并提高效率。

sentence_examples.en: Air waves refer to the radio-frequency spectrum used for wireless transmission of signals.
sentence_examples.zh: 空中电波指用于无线传输信号的射频频谱。

sentence_examples.en: The radio station broadcasts its programs over the air waves.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家广播电台通过空中电波播送节目。

sentence_examples.en: An algorithm is a finite sequence of well-defined instructions to solve a problem or perform a computation.
sentence_examples.zh: 算法是用于解决问题或执行计算的一组明确定义的有限步骤。

sentence_examples.en: Efficient algorithms are crucial for optimizing the performance of software applications.
sentence_examples.zh: 高效的算法对于优化软件应用程序的性能至关重要。

sentence_examples.en: An Algorithm-of-Thought is a cognitive framework that guides reasoning by structuring thought processes into systematic steps.
sentence_examples.zh: 思维算法是一种通过将思考过程系统化为步骤来引导推理的认知框架。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers use Algorithms-of-Thought to improve decision-making efficiency in complex problem-solving scenarios.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员利用思维算法提高复杂问题解决场景中的决策效率。

sentence_examples.en: An analog signal is a continuous signal that represents physical measurements.
sentence_examples.zh: 模拟信号是一种表示物理测量的连续信号。

sentence_examples.en: The old radio uses analog technology to transmit sound waves.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台老式收音机使用模拟技术传输声波。

sentence_examples.en: Animation is the process of creating the illusion of motion and change by rapidly displaying a sequence of static images.
sentence_examples.zh: 动画是通过快速显示一系列静态图像来创造运动和变化错觉的过程。

sentence_examples.en: The software includes powerful tools for 3D animation and rendering.
sentence_examples.zh: 该软件包含用于三维动画和渲染的强大工具。

sentence_examples.en: An annotation is a note or comment added to a text or diagram to provide explanation or metadata.
sentence_examples.zh: 注解是添加到文本或图表中的说明或评注，用于提供解释或元数据。

sentence_examples.en: Developers use annotations in code to add descriptive information without altering the program logic.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者在代码中使用注解来添加描述性信息，而不改变程序逻辑。

sentence_examples.en: An answering machine is a device that automatically answers telephone calls and records messages from callers.
sentence_examples.zh: 电话答录机是一种自动接听电话并录制来电者留言的设备。

sentence_examples.en: She left a message on the answering machine when no one picked up the phone.
sentence_examples.zh: 当无人接听电话时，她在电话答录机上留了言。

sentence_examples.en: An antenna is a device used to transmit or receive radio waves in wireless communication systems.
sentence_examples.zh: 天线是无线通信系统中用于发射或接收无线电波的装置。

sentence_examples.en: The engineer adjusted the antenna to improve signal reception.
sentence_examples.zh: 工程师调整了天线以改善信号接收效果。

sentence_examples.en: An anti-pattern is a common response to a recurring problem that is usually ineffective and risks being highly counterproductive.
sentence_examples.zh: 反模式是对常见重复问题的一种通常无效且可能适得其反的常见解决方式。

sentence_examples.en: The team recognized the anti-pattern in their workflow and decided to refactor the process.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队识别出工作流中的反模式，并决定重构该流程。

sentence_examples.en: Ahead-of-Time (AoT) compilation is a process where code is compiled to machine code before execution rather than at runtime.
sentence_examples.zh: 提前编译（AoT）是指在代码执行前而非运行时将其编译为机器码的过程。

sentence_examples.en: Using AoT compilation can significantly improve startup performance in applications.
sentence_examples.zh: 使用提前编译能显著提升应用程序的启动性能。

sentence_examples.en: APM, or Asynchronous Programming Model, is a design pattern used in software development to handle operations that may take an indeterminate amount of time to complete.
sentence_examples.zh: APM（异步编程模型）是软件开发中用于处理可能需要不确定时间完成的操作的设计模式。

sentence_examples.en: Developers often use APM to improve application responsiveness by executing long-running tasks in the background.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者常使用APM通过在后台执行长时间运行的任务来提高应用程序的响应能力。

sentence_examples.en: An apocalyptic defect is a critical flaw in software that causes complete system failure or catastrophic data loss.
sentence_examples.zh: 灾难性缺陷是指软件中导致系统完全崩溃或数据严重丢失的关键缺陷。

sentence_examples.en: The team worked overtime to fix the apocalyptic defect before the product launch.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队加班加点修复产品发布前的灾难性缺陷。

sentence_examples.en: An application is a software program designed to perform a specific task or set of tasks for end users.
sentence_examples.zh: 应用程序是为最终用户执行特定任务或一组任务而设计的软件程序。

sentence_examples.en: Mobile applications are commonly downloaded from app stores to smartphones.
sentence_examples.zh: 移动应用程序通常从应用商店下载到智能手机上。

sentence_examples.en: The application life cycle refers to the stages an application goes through from initialization to termination.
sentence_examples.zh: 应用生命周期指应用程序从初始化到终止所经历的各个阶段。

sentence_examples.en: Developers must manage the application life cycle to ensure smooth performance and resource cleanup.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者必须管理应用生命周期，以确保流畅的性能和资源清理。

sentence_examples.en: An application pool is a group of one or more worker processes configured to serve web applications in IIS.
sentence_examples.zh: 应用程序池是IIS中配置的一组工作进程，用于服务Web应用程序。

sentence_examples.en: Administrators can isolate applications by assigning them to different application pools for better security and reliability.
sentence_examples.zh: 管理员可通过将应用程序分配到不同的应用程序池来实现隔离，从而提高安全性和可靠性。

sentence_examples.en: An Application Programming Interface (API) is a set of protocols, routines, and tools for building software applications that specify how software components interact.
sentence_examples.zh: 应用程序编程接口（API）是一组用于构建软件应用的协议、例程和工具，规定了软件组件之间的交互方式。

sentence_examples.en: Developers use APIs to access the functionality of external services without needing to understand their internal implementation.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者通过应用编程接口使用外部服务的功能，而无需了解其内部实现。

sentence_examples.en: An application service is a software component that provides specific functionality to support the operation of an application.
sentence_examples.zh: 应用服务是为支持应用程序运行而提供特定功能的软件组件。

sentence_examples.en: The cloud platform offers various application services to streamline development and deployment processes.
sentence_examples.zh: 该云平台提供多种应用服务，以简化开发和部署流程。

sentence_examples.en: An arbitrary error is a deviation from accuracy or correctness that occurs unpredictably and without a specific pattern.
sentence_examples.zh: 任意误差是指无法预测且无特定模式的准确性或正确性偏差。

sentence_examples.en: The system's arbitrary errors made it difficult to pinpoint the root cause of the failure.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统的随机错误使得难以确定故障的根本原因。

sentence_examples.en: Computer architecture refers to the design and organization of a computer system's hardware components and their interactions.
sentence_examples.zh: 计算机架构指的是计算机系统硬件组件及其交互的设计和组织。

sentence_examples.en: The software architecture defines the high-level structure of a program and its components.
sentence_examples.zh: 软件体系结构定义了程序及其组件的高层次结构。

sentence_examples.en: Architecture decay refers to the gradual degradation of a software system's structural integrity due to unplanned changes and technical debt.
sentence_examples.zh: 架构腐化指软件系统因未规划的变更和技术债务导致结构完整性逐渐退化。

sentence_examples.en: If left unchecked, architecture decay can lead to increased maintenance costs and reduced system reliability.
sentence_examples.zh: 若不加以控制，架构腐化会导致维护成本上升和系统可靠性下降。

sentence_examples.en: An architecture style is a set of principles and patterns that guide the design of software systems.
sentence_examples.zh: 架构风格是指导软件系统设计的一系列原则和模式。

sentence_examples.en: Common architecture styles include layered, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
sentence_examples.zh: 常见的架构风格包括分层架构、微服务架构和事件驱动架构。

sentence_examples.en: ARPA, the Advanced Research Projects Agency, was established by the U.S. Department of Defense to fund and oversee innovative research in technology.
sentence_examples.zh: 高级研究计划署（ARPA）由美国国防部设立，旨在资助和监督技术创新研究。

sentence_examples.en: Many groundbreaking technologies, including the early internet, originated from projects funded by ARPA.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多开创性技术，包括早期的互联网，都源自ARPA资助的项目。

sentence_examples.en: ARPAnet was the precursor to the modern internet, developed by the U.S. Department of Defense in the late 1960s.
sentence_examples.zh: 阿帕网是现代互联网的前身，由美国国防部于20世纪60年代末开发。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers used ARPAnet to share data and communicate across different locations.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员使用阿帕网在不同地点共享数据和进行交流。

sentence_examples.en: Arrange-Act-Assert is a pattern for structuring unit tests by separating setup, execution, and verification into distinct phases.
sentence_examples.zh: 安排-执行-断言是一种单元测试模式，通过将设置、执行和验证分为不同阶段来组织测试。

sentence_examples.en: In the Arrange phase of Arrange-Act-Assert, developers initialize objects and prepare test data.
sentence_examples.zh: 在安排-执行-断言模式的安排阶段，开发者初始化对象并准备测试数据。

sentence_examples.en: An artifact in software development is any tangible by-product produced during the development process, such as a document, model, or executable file.
sentence_examples.zh: 在软件开发中，工件是指开发过程中产生的任何有形副产品，如文档、模型或可执行文件。

sentence_examples.en: The build process generated several artifacts that were stored in the repository for later deployment.
sentence_examples.zh: 构建过程生成了多个工件，并存储在仓库中以供后续部署。

sentence_examples.en: Aspect-Oriented Programming is a programming paradigm that aims to increase modularity by allowing the separation of cross-cutting concerns.
sentence_examples.zh: 面向切面编程是一种通过分离横切关注点来提高模块化程度的编程范式。

sentence_examples.en: Developers use Aspect-Oriented Programming to handle logging, security, and transactions in a more maintainable way.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者使用面向切面编程以更可维护的方式处理日志记录、安全性和事务。

sentence_examples.en: The aspect ratio of a display is the proportional relationship between its width and height.
sentence_examples.zh: 显示器的宽高比是其宽度和高度之间的比例关系。

sentence_examples.en: Most modern monitors use a 16:9 aspect ratio for widescreen content.
sentence_examples.zh: 大多数现代显示器采用16:9的宽高比来播放宽屏内容。

sentence_examples.en: An assembly is a compiled code library in .NET used for deployment, versioning, and security.
sentence_examples.zh: 程序集是 .NET 中用于部署、版本控制和安全的已编译代码库。

sentence_examples.en: The developer debugged the assembly to identify the source of the runtime error.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者调试了该程序集以找出运行时错误的原因。

sentence_examples.en: An associative array is a data structure that stores key-value pairs, allowing efficient lookup by key.
sentence_examples.zh: 关联数组是一种存储键值对的数据结构，能够通过键高效查找。

sentence_examples.en: Programmers often use associative arrays to represent dictionaries or hash tables in code.
sentence_examples.zh: 程序员常用关联数组在代码中表示字典或哈希表。

sentence_examples.en: The Asynchronous Programming Model is a design pattern used to handle operations that may take an unpredictable amount of time to complete without blocking the execution of other tasks.
sentence_examples.zh: 异步编程模型是一种设计模式，用于处理可能需要不可预测时间完成的操作，同时不阻塞其他任务的执行。

sentence_examples.en: Developers often use the Asynchronous Programming Model to improve responsiveness in applications that perform I/O-bound operations.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者通常使用异步编程模型来提高执行I/O密集型操作的应用程序的响应速度。

sentence_examples.en: ATM, or Asynchronous Transfer Mode, is a networking technology that transmits data in fixed-size cells.
sentence_examples.zh: ATM（异步传输模式）是一种以固定大小信元传输数据的网络技术。

sentence_examples.en: The telecom provider upgraded its infrastructure to support ATM for faster data transfer.
sentence_examples.zh: 该电信运营商升级了基础设施以支持ATM，实现更快的数据传输。

sentence_examples.en: An atomic operation is an indivisible and uninterruptible set of instructions that executes as a single unit.
sentence_examples.zh: 原子操作是一组不可分割且不可中断的指令，作为单一单元执行。

sentence_examples.en: The database ensures data consistency by using atomic operations for transactions.
sentence_examples.zh: 数据库通过对事务使用原子操作来确保数据一致性。

sentence_examples.en: An atomic transaction is a set of operations that either all occur, or none occur, ensuring data consistency.
sentence_examples.zh: 原子事务是一组要么全部执行、要么全部不执行的操作，以确保数据一致性。

sentence_examples.en: The database system guarantees that atomic transactions will not be partially completed.
sentence_examples.zh: 数据库系统保证原子事务不会被部分完成。

sentence_examples.en: Atomicity is a guarantee of isolation from concurrent processes, ensuring that an operation either completes entirely or not at all.
sentence_examples.zh: 原子性保证操作与并发进程隔离，确保操作要么完全完成，要么完全不执行。

sentence_examples.en: Database transactions rely on atomicity to maintain data integrity during failures.
sentence_examples.zh: 数据库事务依赖原子性在故障时维护数据完整性。

sentence_examples.en: An attribute is a declarative tag in code that provides metadata about program elements such as types, methods, or properties.
sentence_examples.zh: 属性是代码中的声明性标签，用于提供有关类型、方法或属性等程序元素的元数据。

sentence_examples.en: In C#, developers use attributes to add additional information to classes or methods that can be retrieved at runtime.
sentence_examples.zh: 在 C# 中，开发者使用特性为类或方法添加可在运行时检索的额外信息。

sentence_examples.en: Augmented reality is a technology that overlays digital information onto the real world.
sentence_examples.zh: 增强现实是一种将数字信息叠加到现实世界的技术。

sentence_examples.en: Many mobile apps now use augmented reality to enhance user experience.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多移动应用现在使用增强现实来提升用户体验。

sentence_examples.en: Authentication is the process of verifying the identity of a user or system.
sentence_examples.zh: 身份验证是验证用户或系统身份的过程。

sentence_examples.en: Multi-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to the login process.
sentence_examples.zh: 多因素认证为登录过程增加了额外的安全层。

sentence_examples.en: Authorization is the process of granting someone permission to access a resource or perform an action.
sentence_examples.zh: 授权是指允许某人访问资源或执行操作的过程。

sentence_examples.en: The system requires proper authorization before allowing any changes to sensitive data.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统在允许修改敏感数据之前需要适当的授权。

sentence_examples.en: Auto-generated properties are attributes created automatically by a system or framework without manual coding.
sentence_examples.zh: 自动生成属性是由系统或框架自动创建的属性，无需手动编码。

sentence_examples.en: The ORM framework provides auto-generated properties to simplify database interactions.
sentence_examples.zh: ORM框架提供自动生成属性，以简化数据库交互。

sentence_examples.en: Automated unit testing is the practice of using software tools to run repeatable tests on individual components of a program.
sentence_examples.zh: 自动化单元测试是指使用软件工具对程序的单个组件运行可重复测试的实践。

sentence_examples.en: Developers rely on automated unit testing to catch bugs early in the development cycle.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发人员依赖自动化单元测试在开发周期早期发现错误。

sentence_examples.en: Automation refers to the use of technology to perform tasks without human intervention.
sentence_examples.zh: 自动化指的是使用技术在无人干预的情况下执行任务。

sentence_examples.en: The factory implemented automation to increase production efficiency.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家工厂采用了自动化来提高生产效率。

sentence_examples.en: An autonomous system is a network or set of networks controlled by a single administrative entity using a consistent routing policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 自治系统是由单一管理实体使用一致路由策略控制的网络或网络集合。

sentence_examples.en: The robot operates as an autonomous agent, making decisions without human intervention.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台机器人作为自主代理运行，无需人工干预即可做出决策。

sentence_examples.en: An auxiliary database is a secondary database used to support or enhance the functionality of a primary database.
sentence_examples.zh: 辅助数据库是用于支持或增强主数据库功能的次级数据库。

sentence_examples.en: The system automatically syncs updates from the main database to the auxiliary database.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统自动将主数据库的更新同步到辅助数据库。

sentence_examples.en: Availability refers to the proportion of time a system is in a functioning condition and accessible for use.
sentence_examples.zh: 可用性指系统处于可运行状态并可被访问的时间比例。

sentence_examples.en: High availability is critical for servers that must remain operational around the clock.
sentence_examples.zh: 高可用性对于需要全天候运行的服务器至关重要。

sentence_examples.en: An availability set is a logical grouping of virtual machines that allows cloud providers to ensure high availability and fault tolerance.
sentence_examples.zh: 可用性集合是虚拟机的逻辑分组，使云提供商能够确保高可用性和容错能力。

sentence_examples.en: By distributing virtual machines across an availability set, you minimize the risk of simultaneous downtime.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过将虚拟机分布在可用性集合中，可以降低同时宕机的风险。

sentence_examples.en: Availability Zones (AZs) are distinct locations within a cloud region that are engineered to be isolated from failures in other zones.
sentence_examples.zh: 可用区（AZs）是云区域内相互隔离的独立位置，旨在避免其他区域故障的影响。

sentence_examples.en: The application was deployed across multiple AZs to ensure high availability and fault tolerance.
sentence_examples.zh: 该应用部署在多个可用区中，以确保高可用性和容错能力。

sentence_examples.en: BaaS (Backend as a Service) is a cloud computing model that provides developers with backend services such as databases, authentication, and APIs.
sentence_examples.zh: BaaS（后端即服务）是一种云计算模型，为开发者提供数据库、身份验证和API等后端服务。

sentence_examples.en: Many startups adopt BaaS to accelerate development by outsourcing backend infrastructure management.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多初创公司采用BaaS来加速开发，通过外包后端基础设施管理。

sentence_examples.en: Backend as a Service (BaaS) is a cloud computing model that provides developers with pre-built backend infrastructure and services to accelerate application development.
sentence_examples.zh: 后端即服务（BaaS）是一种云计算模式，为开发者提供预构建的后端基础设施和服务，以加速应用开发。

sentence_examples.en: Many startups use Backend as a Service to reduce the time and cost of building server-side components from scratch.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多初创公司使用后端即服务来减少从零构建服务器端组件的时间和成本。

sentence_examples.en: A backplane is a circuit board that connects multiple connectors in parallel to allow signal routing between modules.
sentence_examples.zh: 背板是一种电路板，通过并行连接多个接口来实现模块间的信号路由。

sentence_examples.en: The server chassis includes a high-speed backplane for data transmission between components.
sentence_examples.zh: 该服务器机箱包含一个高速背板，用于组件间的数据传输。

sentence_examples.en: Backward compatibility is the ability of a system to work with input from earlier versions of itself.
sentence_examples.zh: 向后兼容是指系统能够处理自身早期版本输入的能力。

sentence_examples.en: The software update maintained backward compatibility with older file formats.
sentence_examples.zh: 此次软件更新保持了对旧文件格式的向后兼容。

sentence_examples.en: Bandwidth is the maximum rate of data transfer across a given network path or connection.
sentence_examples.zh: 带宽是指在给定网络路径或连接上数据传输的最大速率。

sentence_examples.en: The video streaming service requires a high bandwidth to deliver smooth playback.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项视频流媒体服务需要高带宽才能实现流畅播放。

sentence_examples.en: A bar code is a machine-readable pattern of parallel lines that represents data identifying a product.
sentence_examples.zh: 条形码是由平行线组成的机器可读图案，用于表示标识产品的数据。

sentence_examples.en: The cashier scanned the bar code on the package to check its price.
sentence_examples.zh: 收银员扫描了包装上的条形码以查看价格。

sentence_examples.en: The Base Class Library is a collection of reusable classes, interfaces, and value types that provide access to system functionality in the .NET framework.
sentence_examples.zh: 基类库是.NET框架中提供系统功能访问的一组可重用类、接口和值类型。

sentence_examples.en: Developers rely on the Base Class Library to handle common programming tasks such as file I/O, string manipulation, and network communication.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者依赖基类库处理常见编程任务，如文件I/O、字符串操作和网络通信。

sentence_examples.en: A baseline is a reference point or standard used for comparison in measurements or evaluations.
sentence_examples.zh: 基线是用于测量或评估时的参考点或标准。

sentence_examples.en: The project team established a performance baseline to track improvements over time.
sentence_examples.zh: 项目团队建立了性能基准以跟踪随时间的改进。

sentence_examples.en: Baud is a unit of measurement that represents the number of signal changes per second in a communication channel.
sentence_examples.zh: 波特是通信信道中每秒信号变化次数的度量单位。

sentence_examples.en: The modem supports data transmission at 9600 baud for reliable connectivity.
sentence_examples.zh: 该调制解调器支持9600波特的数据传输，以确保可靠的连接。

sentence_examples.en: The Base Class Library (BCL) is a standard library available to all languages using the .NET Framework.
sentence_examples.zh: 基类库（BCL）是所有使用 .NET Framework 的语言均可访问的标准库。

sentence_examples.en: Developers rely on the BCL for fundamental operations like file I/O and string manipulation.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者依赖基类库进行文件输入输出和字符串操作等基础操作。

sentence_examples.en: In computing, a bear process is one that places a heavy load on system resources.
sentence_examples.zh: 在计算中，bear进程指的是对系统资源造成重负载的进程。

sentence_examples.en: The server struggled to bear the sudden surge in user requests during peak hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 服务器在高峰时段难以承受突发的用户请求激增。

sentence_examples.en: Behavior refers to the actions or reactions of an object or system in response to external stimuli.
sentence_examples.zh: 行为指的是对象或系统对外部刺激的动作或反应。

sentence_examples.en: The software's unexpected behavior was traced back to a bug in the code.
sentence_examples.zh: 该软件的异常表现被追溯到代码中的一个错误。

sentence_examples.en: Behavior-preserving program transformations are modifications to a program that alter its structure without changing its observable behavior.
sentence_examples.zh: 行为保持程序变换是指在不改变程序可观察行为的前提下，对其结构进行的修改。

sentence_examples.en: Refactoring tools often rely on behavior-preserving program transformations to improve code quality.
sentence_examples.zh: 重构工具通常依赖行为保持程序变换来提升代码质量。

sentence_examples.en: Behavioral design patterns are software design patterns that identify common communication patterns among objects and realize these patterns.
sentence_examples.zh: 行为设计模式是识别对象间常见通信模式并实现这些模式的软件设计模式。

sentence_examples.en: The Observer pattern, a type of behavioral design pattern, allows objects to notify dependencies when state changes occur.
sentence_examples.zh: 观察者模式作为一种行为设计模式，允许对象在状态变化时通知依赖项。

sentence_examples.en: A behavioral error is a mistake caused by incorrect actions or decisions made by a user or system component.
sentence_examples.zh: 行为错误是指用户或系统组件因不当操作或决策导致的错误。

sentence_examples.en: Debugging often involves identifying and correcting behavioral errors in software.
sentence_examples.zh: 调试通常包括识别和纠正软件中的行为错误。

translations.translation: 双向编码器表示转换器

sentence_examples.en: BERT is a large language model developed by Google that uses a bidirectional approach to capture context from both left and right of a word, improving performance on various natural language processing tasks.
sentence_examples.zh: BERT是由谷歌开发的大型语言模型，采用双向方法从词的左右两侧捕捉上下文，提升了多种自然语言处理任务的性能。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers fine-tune BERT for specific applications such as sentiment analysis and named entity recognition.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员针对情感分析和命名实体识别等特定应用对BERT模型进行微调。

sentence_examples.en: A BFF (Backend For Frontend) is a server-side layer designed specifically to serve the needs of a frontend application.
sentence_examples.zh: BFF（为前端服务的后端）是专为满足前端应用需求而设计的服务器端层。

sentence_examples.en: The development team implemented a BFF to optimize data fetching for their mobile app.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发团队实现了一个 BFF 来优化其移动应用的数据获取。

sentence_examples.en: BFS is an algorithm for traversing or searching tree or graph data structures, starting from the root node and exploring all neighbor nodes at the present depth before moving on to nodes at the next depth level.
sentence_examples.zh: BFS是一种用于遍历或搜索树或图数据结构的算法，从根节点开始，先探索当前深度的所有相邻节点，再移动到下一深度层级的节点。

sentence_examples.en: The programmer implemented BFS to find the shortest path in an unweighted graph.
sentence_examples.zh: 程序员使用BFS在无权图中寻找最短路径。

sentence_examples.en: A Big Ball of Mud is a software system that lacks a perceivable architecture and is difficult to maintain.
sentence_examples.zh: “大泥球”是指缺乏可感知架构且难以维护的软件系统。

sentence_examples.en: The development team inherited a Big Ball of Mud and spent months refactoring it.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发团队接手了一个混乱的系统，花了数月时间进行重构。

sentence_examples.en: Big data refers to extremely large datasets that are analyzed computationally to reveal patterns, trends, and associations.
sentence_examples.zh: 大数据指通过计算分析揭示模式、趋势和关联的海量数据集。

sentence_examples.en: Companies leverage big data to improve decision-making and optimize business processes.
sentence_examples.zh: 企业利用大数据改进决策并优化业务流程。

sentence_examples.en: Big Design Up Front is a software development approach where most design activities are completed before implementation begins.
sentence_examples.zh: 预先大量设计是一种软件开发方法，其中大部分设计工作在实施开始前完成。

sentence_examples.en: Critics argue that Big Design Up Front can lead to inflexibility in adapting to changing requirements.
sentence_examples.zh: 批评者认为预先大量设计可能导致难以适应不断变化的需求。

sentence_examples.en: Binary is a base-2 number system that uses only two digits, 0 and 1, to represent data in computing.
sentence_examples.zh: 二进制是一种基于2的数字系统，仅使用0和1两个数字在计算中表示数据。

sentence_examples.en: The computer processes all information in binary form.
sentence_examples.zh: 计算机以二进制形式处理所有信息。

sentence_examples.en: Binocular vision refers to the ability to use both eyes together to perceive a single three-dimensional image.
sentence_examples.zh: 双目视觉指的是同时使用双眼感知单一三维图像的能力。

sentence_examples.en: She used a binocular to observe the distant birds clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用双筒望远镜清晰地观察远处的鸟类。

sentence_examples.en: A bit is the smallest unit of data in computing, representing a binary value of either 0 or 1.
sentence_examples.zh: 比特是计算中的最小数据单位，表示二进制值0或1。

sentence_examples.en: The processor handles data in 64-bit chunks for faster performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 处理器以64位为单位处理数据，以提高性能。

sentence_examples.en: A bit-field is a data structure in programming that allows the packing of multiple small values into a single machine word to save storage space.
sentence_examples.zh: 位域是一种编程数据结构，允许将多个小值打包到单个机器字中以节省存储空间。

sentence_examples.en: The programmer defined a bit-field to efficiently store the flags in the configuration register.
sentence_examples.zh: 程序员定义了一个位域，以高效地存储配置寄存器中的标志位。

sentence_examples.en: A bitnik is a person who is deeply involved in the early culture of personal computing and digital technology.
sentence_examples.zh: 比特尼克指深度参与早期个人计算机和数字技术文化的人。

sentence_examples.en: The term bitnik emerged in the 1980s to describe tech enthusiasts who embraced the hacker ethos.
sentence_examples.zh: “比特尼克”一词在20世纪80年代出现，用于描述拥抱黑客精神的技术爱好者。

sentence_examples.en: A blob is a collection of binary data stored as a single entity in a database system.
sentence_examples.zh: Blob是数据库系统中作为单一实体存储的二进制数据集合。

sentence_examples.en: The application processes the image blob before displaying it on the screen.
sentence_examples.zh: 应用程序在屏幕显示前处理该图像数据块。

sentence_examples.en: A block is a contiguous set of bits or bytes that forms an identifiable unit of data.
sentence_examples.zh: 块是形成可识别数据单元的连续位或字节集合。

sentence_examples.en: The firewall was configured to block unauthorized access attempts.
sentence_examples.zh: 防火墙被配置为阻断未经授权的访问尝试。

sentence_examples.en: A block blob is a type of storage object in cloud computing that is optimized for storing large amounts of unstructured data, such as text or binary data.
sentence_examples.zh: 块 blob 是云计算中的一种存储对象，专为存储大量非结构化数据（如文本或二进制数据）而优化。

sentence_examples.en: Developers often use block blobs to handle files that are frequently updated in chunks.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者常使用块 blob 处理以块为单位频繁更新的文件。

sentence_examples.en: Blockchain as a Service is a cloud-based offering that allows users to develop, host, and manage blockchain applications without building their own infrastructure.
sentence_examples.zh: 区块链即服务是一种基于云的服务，允许用户开发、托管和管理区块链应用，而无需自建基础设施。

sentence_examples.en: Many enterprises adopt Blockchain as a Service to streamline their blockchain adoption process.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多企业采用区块链即服务来简化其区块链应用流程。

sentence_examples.en: A bottleneck is a point in a system where the flow of data or processes is significantly slowed or restricted.
sentence_examples.zh: 瓶颈是系统中数据流或处理流程显著减慢或受限的点。

sentence_examples.en: The development team identified the database query as the main bottleneck in the application's performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发团队确定数据库查询是应用程序性能的主要瓶颈。

sentence_examples.en: A bounded context is a central pattern in Domain-Driven Design that defines the boundaries within which a particular model is defined and applicable.
sentence_examples.zh: 限界上下文是领域驱动设计中的核心模式，定义了特定模型的适用边界。

sentence_examples.en: Each bounded context in the system ensures that terms and rules remain consistent within its scope.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统中的每个限界上下文确保术语和规则在其范围内保持一致。

sentence_examples.en: In computer science, a box is a container data structure used to hold or encapsulate values or objects.
sentence_examples.zh: 在计算机科学中，盒是一种用于存放或封装值或对象的容器数据结构。

sentence_examples.en: The function boxes the integer value before passing it to the generic method.
sentence_examples.zh: 该函数在将整数值传递给泛型方法之前先对其进行装箱。

sentence_examples.en: Bps, or bits per second, is a unit of measurement for data transfer rates in digital communications.
sentence_examples.zh: bps（比特每秒）是数字通信中数据传输速率的度量单位。

sentence_examples.en: The modem supports speeds up to 56,000 bps for internet connectivity.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款调制解调器支持最高56,000比特每秒的互联网连接速度。

sentence_examples.en: Brainstorming is a group creativity technique designed to generate a large number of ideas for solving a problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 头脑风暴是一种集体创意技术，旨在为解决问题产生大量想法。

sentence_examples.en: During the meeting, we used brainstorming to come up with innovative marketing strategies.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议期间，我们通过头脑风暴提出了创新的营销策略。

sentence_examples.en: A BRD is a formal document that outlines the business objectives and requirements for a project.
sentence_examples.zh: BRD是一份正式文档，概述项目的业务目标和需求。

sentence_examples.en: The development team reviewed the BRD to ensure alignment with business goals.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发团队审阅了BRD，以确保与业务目标保持一致。

sentence_examples.en: A breakpoint is a designated point in a program where execution is paused for debugging purposes.
sentence_examples.zh: 断点是程序中指定的位置，用于在调试时暂停执行。

sentence_examples.en: The developer set a breakpoint to inspect the variable values during runtime.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者设置了一个断点，以便在运行时检查变量值。

sentence_examples.en: A bridge is a networking device that connects multiple network segments at the data link layer.
sentence_examples.zh: 网桥是一种在数据链路层连接多个网段的网络设备。

sentence_examples.en: The IT team decided to bridge the two local area networks to improve communication efficiency.
sentence_examples.zh: IT团队决定桥接两个局域网以提高通信效率。

sentence_examples.en: The Bridge Pattern is a structural design pattern that decouples an abstraction from its implementation so that the two can vary independently.
sentence_examples.zh: 桥接模式是一种结构型设计模式，它将抽象与实现解耦，使两者可以独立变化。

sentence_examples.en: By using the Bridge Pattern, developers can avoid a permanent binding between an abstraction and its implementation.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过使用桥接模式，开发者可以避免抽象与实现之间的永久绑定。

sentence_examples.en: A broadcast is the transmission of audio or video content to a dispersed audience via any electronic mass communications medium.
sentence_examples.zh: 广播是指通过任何电子大众传播媒介向分散的受众传输音频或视频内容。

sentence_examples.en: The radio station will broadcast the news at 6 PM.
sentence_examples.zh: 电台将在晚上六点广播新闻。

sentence_examples.en: A broken hierarchy is a hierarchical structure that has lost its intended organization or integrity, often leading to inconsistencies or errors.
sentence_examples.zh: 破碎层次结构指层次结构失去预期的组织性或完整性，常导致不一致或错误。

sentence_examples.en: The system failed because the broken hierarchy made it impossible to locate the correct parent node.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统故障是因为破碎层次结构导致无法找到正确的父节点。

sentence_examples.en: Broken modularization refers to a design flaw where components intended to be independent and reusable are tightly coupled, defeating the purpose of modularity.
sentence_examples.zh: 模块化破损指的是组件本应独立且可复用，却紧密耦合的设计缺陷，从而失去模块化的意义。

sentence_examples.en: The system suffered from broken modularization, making it difficult to update individual modules without affecting others.
sentence_examples.zh: 该系统因模块化失效而难以单独更新模块，修改一个模块会影响其他模块。

sentence_examples.en: A brownfield project refers to software development work on an existing system that is already in operation.
sentence_examples.zh: 棕地项目指的是对已投入运行的现有系统进行的软件开发工作。

sentence_examples.en: Developers often face legacy code challenges when working on a brownfield project.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发人员在棕地项目中常常会遇到遗留代码的挑战。

sentence_examples.en: The Browser Object Model is a hierarchy of objects provided by the browser to interact with the window and its components.
sentence_examples.zh: 浏览器对象模型是浏览器提供的用于与窗口及其组件交互的对象层次结构。

sentence_examples.en: Developers use the Browser Object Model to access and manipulate browser-specific features like the history or screen dimensions.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者使用浏览器对象模型访问和操作浏览器特定功能，如历史记录或屏幕尺寸。

sentence_examples.en: A browser-server architecture is a computing model where the client runs in a web browser and the server handles data processing and storage.
sentence_examples.zh: 浏览器-服务器架构是一种计算模型，其中客户端在网络浏览器中运行，而服务器处理数据和存储。

sentence_examples.en: Modern web applications often adopt a browser-server model to improve scalability and user experience.
sentence_examples.zh: 现代网络应用通常采用浏览器-服务器模型，以提高可扩展性和用户体验。

sentence_examples.en: A bug is an error, flaw, or fault in a computer program or system that causes it to behave unexpectedly.
sentence_examples.zh: Bug是指计算机程序或系统中的错误、缺陷或故障，导致其行为异常。

sentence_examples.en: The developers spent hours debugging the software to fix the critical bug.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发人员花了数小时调试软件，以修复这个严重的漏洞。

sentence_examples.en: The Builder Pattern is a creational design pattern that separates the construction of a complex object from its representation.
sentence_examples.zh: 生成器模式是一种创建型设计模式，将复杂对象的构建与其表示分离。

sentence_examples.en: By using the Builder Pattern, developers can create different representations of an object using the same construction process.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过使用生成器模式，开发者可以使用相同的构建过程创建对象的不同表示。

sentence_examples.en: A built-in function is a function that is already defined within a programming language and can be used without additional implementation.
sentence_examples.zh: 内置函数是编程语言中已预先定义的函数，无需额外实现即可使用。

sentence_examples.en: The software comes with built-in security features to protect user data.
sentence_examples.zh: 该软件具有内建的安全功能，用于保护用户数据。

sentence_examples.en: A bulkhead is a partition or wall used to divide a space, often for structural or safety purposes in engineering and architecture.
sentence_examples.zh: 隔板是一种用于分隔空间的隔断或墙壁，常用于工程和建筑中以满足结构或安全需求。

sentence_examples.en: The submarine's bulkheads were reinforced to withstand extreme water pressure.
sentence_examples.zh: 潜艇的舱壁被加固以承受极端的水压。

sentence_examples.en: Business intelligence refers to technologies and strategies used by enterprises to analyze business data and support decision-making.
sentence_examples.zh: 商业智能指企业用于分析业务数据并支持决策的技术和策略。

sentence_examples.en: The company implemented a business intelligence system to improve its operational efficiency.
sentence_examples.zh: 该公司实施了商业智能系统以提高运营效率。

sentence_examples.en: The business layer is the part of a software application that handles the core business logic and rules.
sentence_examples.zh: 业务层是软件应用中处理核心业务逻辑和规则的部分。

sentence_examples.en: Developers often separate the business layer from the presentation layer to improve maintainability.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者通常将业务层与表示层分离，以提高可维护性。

sentence_examples.en: The business logic layer is the part of a software application that handles the core functionality and rules of the business.
sentence_examples.zh: 业务逻辑层是软件应用中处理业务核心功能和规则的部分。

sentence_examples.en: Developers often separate the business logic layer from the presentation layer to improve maintainability.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者通常将业务逻辑层与表示层分离，以提高可维护性。

sentence_examples.en: A Business Requirements Document outlines the high-level business needs and objectives for a project.
sentence_examples.zh: 业务需求文档概述了项目的高层业务需求和目标。

sentence_examples.en: The team reviewed the Business Requirements Document to ensure alignment with stakeholder expectations.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队审阅了业务需求文档，以确保与利益相关者的期望保持一致。

sentence_examples.en: A busy status indicates that a system or device is currently occupied and unable to accept new requests.
sentence_examples.zh: 忙碌状态表示系统或设备当前正在占用，无法接受新请求。

sentence_examples.en: The server returned a busy status when too many users tried to access it simultaneously.
sentence_examples.zh: 当过多用户同时尝试访问时，服务器返回了忙碌状态。

sentence_examples.en: A byte is a unit of digital information that most commonly consists of eight bits.
sentence_examples.zh: 字节是数字信息的基本单位，通常由八个比特组成。

sentence_examples.en: The file size is measured in bytes, kilobytes, or megabytes.
sentence_examples.zh: 文件大小通常以字节、千字节或兆字节为单位衡量。

sentence_examples.en: A cable is an assembly of one or more wires running side by side or bundled, used to carry electric current or transmit data.
sentence_examples.zh: 电缆是由一根或多根导线并排或捆绑而成的组件，用于传输电流或数据。

sentence_examples.en: The technician replaced the damaged cable to restore internet connectivity.
sentence_examples.zh: 技术人员更换了损坏的缆线以恢复网络连接。

sentence_examples.en: A cache is a hardware or software component that stores data so future requests for that data can be served faster.
sentence_examples.zh: 高速缓存是一种硬件或软件组件，用于存储数据以便未来对该数据的请求能够更快响应。

sentence_examples.en: The system caches frequently accessed files to improve performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统缓存频繁访问的文件以提升性能。

sentence_examples.en: A call stack is a data structure that stores information about the active subroutines of a computer program.
sentence_examples.zh: 调用栈是一种存储计算机程序活动子程序信息的数据结构。

sentence_examples.en: The debugger allows developers to inspect the call stack to trace the execution flow.
sentence_examples.zh: 调试器允许开发者检查调用栈以跟踪执行流程。

sentence_examples.en: A callout box is a graphical element used to highlight or annotate specific parts of an image or diagram.
sentence_examples.zh: 标注框是一种用于突出或注释图像或图表特定部分的图形元素。

sentence_examples.en: The designer added a callout box to explain the key features of the software interface.
sentence_examples.zh: 设计师添加了一个标注框来解释软件界面的关键功能。

sentence_examples.en: CamelCase is a naming convention in which the first letter of each word in a compound word is capitalized, except for the first word.
sentence_examples.zh: 驼峰式命名是一种命名约定，其中复合词中每个单词的首字母大写，但第一个单词除外。

sentence_examples.en: Developers often use camelCase for variable names in programming to improve readability.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者通常在编程中使用驼峰式命名法为变量命名，以提高可读性。

sentence_examples.en: Canary releasing is a technique for deploying software updates to a small subset of users before a full rollout to detect potential issues.
sentence_examples.zh: 金丝雀发布是一种在全面推出前将软件更新部署给少量用户以检测潜在问题的技术。

sentence_examples.en: The team used canary releasing to test the new feature with only 5% of the user base initially.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队最初仅向5%的用户群体使用金丝雀发布来测试新功能。

sentence_examples.en: A carbon copy is a duplicate made by using carbon paper or an electronic equivalent.
sentence_examples.zh: 复写本是通过复写纸或电子方式制作的副本。

sentence_examples.en: The manager requested a carbon copy of the report for his records.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理要求提供报告的副本以备存档。

sentence_examples.en: A carriage return is a control character used to reset a device's position to the beginning of a line of text.
sentence_examples.zh: 回车是一种控制字符，用于将设备的位置重置到文本行的起始处。

sentence_examples.en: In many programming languages, the carriage return character is represented as '\r'.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多编程语言中，回车符表示为 '\r'。

sentence_examples.en: Cascading Style Sheets is a style sheet language used for describing the presentation of a document written in HTML or XML.
sentence_examples.zh: 层叠样式表是一种用于描述HTML或XML文档呈现样式的样式表语言。

sentence_examples.en: Developers use Cascading Style Sheets to separate content from design and ensure consistent styling across web pages.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者使用层叠样式表将内容与设计分离，并确保网页样式的一致性。

sentence_examples.en: Catastrophic failover is an automatic switch to a redundant system when the primary system experiences a critical failure.
sentence_examples.zh: 灾难性故障转移是指主系统发生严重故障时自动切换到冗余系统。

sentence_examples.en: The IT team tested the catastrophic failover procedure to ensure minimal downtime during emergencies.
sentence_examples.zh: IT团队测试了灾难性故障转移流程，以确保紧急情况下停机时间最短。

sentence_examples.en: CD (Continuous Delivery) is a software development practice where code changes are automatically built, tested, and prepared for production release.
sentence_examples.zh: 持续交付（CD）是一种软件开发实践，代码变更会自动构建、测试并准备好发布到生产环境。

sentence_examples.en: The team adopted CD to ensure faster and more reliable software releases.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队采用持续交付以确保更快速、更可靠的软件发布。

sentence_examples.en: Consumer-Driven Contract (CDC) is a pattern used in microservices to ensure that services can evolve independently while maintaining compatibility.
sentence_examples.zh: 消费者驱动契约（CDC）是微服务中使用的一种模式，确保服务能独立演进同时保持兼容性。

sentence_examples.en: By adopting CDC, teams can validate service interactions early in the development cycle.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过采用消费者驱动契约，团队能在开发周期早期验证服务交互。

sentence_examples.en: A CDN is a geographically distributed network of proxy servers and their data centers that provide high availability and performance by caching content close to end users.
sentence_examples.zh: CDN是一个地理上分布的代理服务器及其数据中心网络，通过将内容缓存至接近终端用户的位置来提供高可用性和高性能。

sentence_examples.en: Many websites use a CDN to reduce latency and improve load times for their visitors.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多网站使用CDN来减少延迟并提高访问者的加载速度。

sentence_examples.en: A cell is the smallest unit of a spreadsheet, identified by a unique row and column intersection.
sentence_examples.zh: 单元格是电子表格中最小的组成单位，由唯一的行列交点标识。

sentence_examples.en: The battery consists of multiple cells connected in series to increase voltage.
sentence_examples.zh: 该电池由多个串联的电池单元组成，以提高电压。

sentence_examples.en: A cellular telephone is a portable device that connects to a wireless network to make and receive calls.
sentence_examples.zh: 蜂窝电话是一种通过无线网络拨打和接听电话的便携设备。

sentence_examples.en: Many people use their cellular telephone for internet access as well as communication.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人使用移动电话进行通信和上网。

sentence_examples.en: The Central Processing Unit (CPU) is the primary component of a computer that executes instructions from programs.
sentence_examples.zh: 中央处理器（CPU）是计算机的主要组件，负责执行程序指令。

sentence_examples.en: Modern CPUs contain multiple cores to handle several tasks simultaneously.
sentence_examples.zh: 现代中央处理器包含多个核心，能同时处理多项任务。

sentence_examples.en: A certificate is a digital document that verifies the identity of a person, device, or organization and binds that identity to a public key.
sentence_examples.zh: 证书是一种数字文档，用于验证个人、设备或组织的身份，并将该身份与公钥绑定。

sentence_examples.en: The server uses an SSL certificate to establish a secure connection with the client.
sentence_examples.zh: 服务器使用SSL证书与客户端建立安全连接。

sentence_examples.en: A Certificate Authority is a trusted entity that issues digital certificates to verify the identity of entities on a network.
sentence_examples.zh: 证书颁发机构是一种受信任的实体，负责签发数字证书以验证网络中实体的身份。

sentence_examples.en: The company applied for an SSL certificate from a well-known Certificate Authority to secure its website.
sentence_examples.zh: 该公司向知名认证机构申请了SSL证书，以确保其网站的安全。

sentence_examples.en: The Chain of Responsibility is a behavioral design pattern that passes requests along a chain of handlers until one processes it.
sentence_examples.zh: 责任链是一种行为设计模式，沿着处理程序链传递请求，直到某个处理程序处理它。

sentence_examples.en: By implementing the Chain of Responsibility, we decoupled the sender and receiver of a request.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过实现责任链模式，我们解耦了请求的发送者和接收者。

sentence_examples.en: The Chain of Responsibility Pattern is a behavioral design pattern that passes requests along a chain of handlers until one of them processes the request.
sentence_examples.zh: 责任链模式是一种行为设计模式，沿着处理程序链传递请求，直到其中一个处理程序处理该请求。

sentence_examples.en: By using the Chain of Responsibility Pattern, you can avoid coupling the sender of a request to its receiver.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过使用责任链模式，可以避免将请求的发送者与接收者耦合。

sentence_examples.en: Chain-of-Thought is a prompting technique that encourages language models to generate intermediate reasoning steps before arriving at a final answer.
sentence_examples.zh: 「思维链」是一种提示技术，鼓励语言模型在得出最终答案前生成中间推理步骤。

sentence_examples.en: By using Chain-of-Thought prompting, the model's responses become more interpretable and accurate for complex tasks.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过使用「链式思考」提示，模型在复杂任务中的回答变得更可解释且准确。

sentence_examples.en: Chain-of-Thought-Self-Consistency is a decoding strategy that samples multiple reasoning paths and selects the most consistent answer to improve the reliability of language model outputs.
sentence_examples.zh: 思维链自洽性是一种解码策略，通过采样多条推理路径并选择最一致的答案来提高语言模型输出的可靠性。

sentence_examples.en: By applying Chain-of-Thought-Self-Consistency, researchers observed a significant reduction in logical contradictions in complex problem-solving tasks.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过应用思维链自洽性，研究人员在复杂问题解决任务中观察到逻辑矛盾显著减少。

sentence_examples.en: Change bidirectional association to unidirectional refactors a two-way relationship between classes into a one-way dependency to simplify the design.
sentence_examples.zh: 将双向关联改为单向是将类之间的双向关系重构为单向依赖，以简化设计。

sentence_examples.en: By changing the bidirectional association to unidirectional, we reduced coupling and improved maintainability in the codebase.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过将双向关联改为单向，我们降低了耦合度并提高了代码库的可维护性。

sentence_examples.en: A change point is a specific location in code where a modification is required or has been made.
sentence_examples.zh: 变更点是代码中需要或已经进行修改的特定位置。

sentence_examples.en: Identifying change points early can help prevent bugs during software updates.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽早识别修改点有助于在软件更新期间防止错误。

sentence_examples.en: Change reference to value is a refactoring technique that converts a reference object into a value object to simplify equality comparisons.
sentence_examples.zh: 将引用转换为值是一种重构技术，将引用对象转换为值对象以简化相等性比较。

sentence_examples.en: When you change reference to value, ensure the object is immutable to maintain consistency across instances.
sentence_examples.zh: 将引用转换为值时，确保对象不可变以保持实例间的一致性。

translations.translation: 将单向关联改为双向关联

sentence_examples.en: Change unidirectional association to bidirectional when both classes need to reference each other in object-oriented design.
sentence_examples.zh: 在面向对象设计中，当两个类需要相互引用时，将单向关联改为双向关联。

sentence_examples.en: The refactoring step involves changing unidirectional association to bidirectional to improve navigation between related objects.
sentence_examples.zh: 重构步骤包括将单向关联改为双向关联，以改善相关对象之间的导航。

sentence_examples.en: Change Value to Reference is a refactoring technique that replaces a value object with a reference object to improve performance and memory usage.
sentence_examples.zh: “值转引用”是一种重构技术，通过将值对象替换为引用对象来提升性能和内存使用效率。

sentence_examples.en: When multiple instances of the same data exist, applying Change Value to Reference can reduce redundancy.
sentence_examples.zh: 当同一数据存在多个实例时，采用“值转引用”可减少冗余。

sentence_examples.en: A channel is a communication pathway that transmits data between devices or processes.
sentence_examples.zh: 信道是设备或进程之间传输数据的通信路径。

sentence_examples.en: The television station broadcasts its programs on multiple channels.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家电视台在多个频道播放节目。

sentence_examples.en: A character is a single unit of information, such as a letter, digit, or symbol, used in computing and telecommunications.
sentence_examples.zh: 字符是计算和电信中使用的单个信息单位，如字母、数字或符号。

sentence_examples.en: The program reads each character in the file sequentially to process the data.
sentence_examples.zh: 该程序按顺序读取文件中的每个字符以处理数据。

sentence_examples.en: A characterization test documents the actual behavior of a piece of software to ensure consistency during future modifications.
sentence_examples.zh: 特征测试记录软件的实际行为，以确保未来修改时保持一致性。

sentence_examples.en: Developers write characterization tests to capture existing functionality before refactoring legacy code.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者在重构遗留代码前编写特征测试，以捕获现有功能。

sentence_examples.en: To check in code means to submit changes to a version control system for integration into the main branch.
sentence_examples.zh: 签入代码指将修改提交到版本控制系统，以便合并到主分支。

sentence_examples.en: Developers must check in their completed features before the end of the sprint.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发人员必须在冲刺结束前签入已完成的功能。

sentence_examples.en: To check out in version control means to retrieve a file from the repository for editing.
sentence_examples.zh: 在版本控制中，签出指从代码库获取文件以进行编辑。

sentence_examples.en: After finishing shopping, you need to check out at the counter.
sentence_examples.zh: 购物结束后，你需要在柜台结账离开。

sentence_examples.en: A checksum is a value used to verify the integrity of a file or data transmission.
sentence_examples.zh: 校验和是用于验证文件或数据传输完整性的值。

sentence_examples.en: The system calculates the checksum to detect errors in the received data.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统通过计算校验和来检测接收数据中的错误。

sentence_examples.en: A chip is a small piece of semiconducting material on which an integrated circuit is embedded.
sentence_examples.zh: 芯片是嵌入集成电路的小块半导体材料。

sentence_examples.en: The engineer designed a new chip to improve processing speed.
sentence_examples.zh: 工程师设计了一款新芯片以提高处理速度。

sentence_examples.en: Choreography in computing refers to the design and arrangement of interactions between distributed services without a central coordinator.
sentence_examples.zh: 在计算领域，编排指的是在没有中央协调器的情况下，设计和安排分布式服务之间的交互。

sentence_examples.en: The development team used choreography to enable seamless communication between microservices in the system.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发团队使用协同编排实现系统中微服务之间的无缝通信。

sentence_examples.en: CI, or Continuous Integration, is a software development practice where developers frequently merge code changes into a central repository.
sentence_examples.zh: 持续集成（CI）是一种软件开发实践，开发者频繁地将代码变更合并到中央代码库中。

sentence_examples.en: Automated tests are typically run as part of the CI process to ensure code quality.
sentence_examples.zh: 自动化测试通常作为持续集成流程的一部分运行，以确保代码质量。

sentence_examples.en: A cipher is an algorithm for performing encryption or decryption, transforming data into an unreadable format to protect it.
sentence_examples.zh: 密码是一种用于加密或解密的算法，将数据转换为不可读格式以保护数据。

sentence_examples.en: The ancient Romans used simple substitution ciphers to encode their military messages.
sentence_examples.zh: 古罗马人使用简单的替换密码来加密军事信息。

sentence_examples.en: A claim is a statement asserting something as true, often without providing immediate proof.
sentence_examples.zh: 声明是断言某事为真实的陈述，通常无需立即提供证据。

sentence_examples.en: The researcher claimed that the new algorithm outperforms all existing methods.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员声称新算法优于所有现有方法。

sentence_examples.en: A class definition is a blueprint for creating objects that specifies the attributes and behaviors of the class.
sentence_examples.zh: 类定义是创建对象的蓝图，指定类的属性和行为。

sentence_examples.en: In Python, a class definition begins with the keyword 'class' followed by the class name.
sentence_examples.zh: 在Python中，类定义以关键字'class'开头，后跟类名。

translations.translation: 整洁面向对象分层架构

sentence_examples.en: Clean Object-oriented and Layered Architecture is a software design approach that combines object-oriented principles with layered separation to enhance maintainability and scalability.
sentence_examples.zh: 整洁面向对象分层架构是一种软件设计方法，结合面向对象原则与分层隔离，以提高可维护性和可扩展性。

sentence_examples.en: By adopting Clean Object-oriented and Layered Architecture, developers can isolate business logic from infrastructure concerns.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过采用整洁面向对象分层架构，开发者能将业务逻辑与基础设施关注点分离。

sentence_examples.en: A CLI, or Command Line Interface, is a text-based interface used to interact with software and operating systems by typing commands.
sentence_examples.zh: CLI（命令行界面）是一种通过输入命令与软件和操作系统交互的文本界面。

sentence_examples.en: Developers often prefer using a CLI for its efficiency and scripting capabilities.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者通常偏好使用 CLI，因为它高效且具备脚本功能。

sentence_examples.en: The client-server model is a distributed application structure that partitions tasks between providers of a resource or service, called servers, and service requesters, called clients.
sentence_examples.zh: 客户端-服务器模型是一种分布式应用结构，将任务划分为资源或服务的提供者（称为服务器）和服务请求者（称为客户端）。

sentence_examples.en: In a client-server architecture, the client initiates communication by sending requests to the server.
sentence_examples.zh: 在客户端-服务器架构中，客户端通过向服务器发送请求来发起通信。

sentence_examples.en: A clone is an identical copy of a data structure, object, or biological entity.
sentence_examples.zh: 克隆是数据结构、对象或生物实体的完全相同副本。

sentence_examples.en: Developers often clone repositories to work on the code locally.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者通常复制代码仓库以在本地进行开发。

sentence_examples.en: Cloud computing is the delivery of computing services over the internet to offer faster innovation, flexible resources, and economies of scale.
sentence_examples.zh: 云计算是通过互联网提供计算服务，以实现更快的创新、灵活的资源和规模经济。

sentence_examples.en: Many companies migrate their data storage to cloud computing platforms to reduce costs and improve accessibility.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多公司将数据存储迁移到云计算平台，以降低成本并提高可访问性。

sentence_examples.en: A cloud service is a computing resource delivered over the internet on a pay-as-you-go basis.
sentence_examples.zh: 云服务是通过互联网按需提供的计算资源。

sentence_examples.en: Many businesses migrate their data to a cloud service to reduce infrastructure costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多企业将数据迁移到云服务以减少基础设施成本。

sentence_examples.en: The Common Language Runtime (CLR) is the virtual machine component of Microsoft's .NET framework that manages the execution of .NET programs.
sentence_examples.zh: 公共语言运行时（CLR）是微软 .NET 框架中的虚拟机组件，负责管理 .NET 程序的执行。

sentence_examples.en: Developers rely on the CLR to handle memory management, security, and exception handling in their applications.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者依赖 CLR 来处理应用程序中的内存管理、安全性和异常处理。

sentence_examples.en: CLS (Common Language Specification) defines a set of rules that all .NET languages must follow to ensure interoperability.
sentence_examples.zh: 公共语言规范（CLS）定义了一组所有.NET语言必须遵循的规则，以确保互操作性。

sentence_examples.en: Developers should adhere to CLS guidelines when writing libraries intended for broad use.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发人员在编写供广泛使用的库时，应遵循公共语言规范指南。

sentence_examples.en: A cluster is a group of interconnected computers or servers that work together as a single system.
sentence_examples.zh: 集群是一组相互连接的计算机或服务器，作为单一系统协同工作。

sentence_examples.en: The data points tend to cluster around the mean value in a normal distribution.
sentence_examples.zh: 在正态分布中，数据点往往会聚集在均值附近。

sentence_examples.en: A clustered index determines the physical order of data in a table and stores the data rows in the same order as the index.
sentence_examples.zh: 聚簇索引决定表中数据的物理排序，并按索引顺序存储数据行。

sentence_examples.en: When you create a primary key in most database systems, a clustered index is automatically generated.
sentence_examples.zh: 在大多数数据库系统中创建主键时，会自动生成聚簇索引。

sentence_examples.en: Co-occurring smells refer to multiple code smells that appear simultaneously in the same section of code.
sentence_examples.zh: 共现异味指的是在代码的同一部分中同时出现的多个代码异味。

sentence_examples.en: Detecting co-occurring smells helps developers identify deeper design issues in the software.
sentence_examples.zh: 检测共现异味有助于开发者发现软件中更深层次的设计问题。

sentence_examples.en: CoAP is a specialized web transfer protocol designed for use with constrained nodes and constrained networks in the Internet of Things.
sentence_examples.zh: CoAP是一种专为物联网中受限节点和受限网络设计的网络传输协议。

sentence_examples.en: The device uses CoAP to communicate efficiently with low power consumption.
sentence_examples.zh: 该设备使用CoAP协议以低功耗高效通信。

sentence_examples.en: A coaxial cable is a type of electrical cable consisting of an inner conductor surrounded by a concentric conducting shield, with the two separated by a dielectric insulator.
sentence_examples.zh: 同轴电缆是一种电缆，由内导体和环绕它的同心导电屏蔽层组成，两者之间由绝缘介质隔开。

sentence_examples.en: The network technician installed a coaxial cable to improve signal transmission quality.
sentence_examples.zh: 网络技术员安装了同轴电缆以提高信号传输质量。

translations.translation: 信息及相关技术控制目标

sentence_examples.en: COBIT is a framework for the governance and management of enterprise information and technology, aimed at the whole enterprise.
sentence_examples.zh: COBIT是一个面向整个企业的信息和技术治理与管理框架。

sentence_examples.en: Many organizations adopt COBIT to ensure alignment between IT and business objectives.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多组织采用COBIT框架以确保IT与业务目标保持一致。

sentence_examples.en: CoC (Cost of Change) refers to the expenses incurred when modifying software or systems after initial development.
sentence_examples.zh: CoC（变更成本）指软件或系统在初始开发后进行修改时产生的费用。

sentence_examples.en: Minimizing CoC is a key goal in agile development methodologies.
sentence_examples.zh: 降低变更成本是敏捷开发方法的一个主要目标。

sentence_examples.en: A code smell is a surface indication that usually corresponds to a deeper problem in the system.
sentence_examples.zh: 代码异味通常是系统中更深层问题的表面迹象。

sentence_examples.en: Developers should refactor when they detect a code smell to improve software quality.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者检测到代码异味时应进行重构，以提升软件质量。

translations.translation: 整洁面向对象分层架构

sentence_examples.en: COLA is a clean object-oriented layered architecture designed to improve code maintainability and scalability.
sentence_examples.zh: COLA是一种整洁的面向对象分层架构，旨在提高代码的可维护性和可扩展性。

sentence_examples.en: Many developers adopt COLA to standardize their project structure and reduce complexity.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多开发者采用COLA架构来规范项目结构并降低复杂性。

sentence_examples.en: Collapse hierarchy is a refactoring technique used to merge an unnecessary class hierarchy into a single class.
sentence_examples.zh: 折叠层次结构是一种重构技术，用于将不必要的类层次结构合并为单个类。

sentence_examples.en: The developer decided to collapse the hierarchy to simplify the codebase and reduce complexity.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者决定折叠层次结构以简化代码库并降低复杂性。

sentence_examples.en: Concurrency is the ability of a system to handle multiple tasks at the same time by interleaving their execution.
sentence_examples.zh: 并发是指系统通过交替执行多个任务来同时处理它们的能力。

sentence_examples.en: Programming languages like Go and Rust provide built-in support for concurrency to improve performance.
sentence_examples.zh: Go 和 Rust 等编程语言内置了对并发的支持，以提升性能。

sentence_examples.en: A command is an instruction given to a computer program to perform a specific task.
sentence_examples.zh: 命令是给计算机程序的指令，用于执行特定任务。

sentence_examples.en: The system administrator commanded the server to restart immediately.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统管理员命令服务器立即重启。

sentence_examples.en: The Command Pattern is a behavioral design pattern that turns a request into a stand-alone object, containing all information about the request.
sentence_examples.zh: 命令模式是一种行为设计模式，将请求转换为独立对象，包含请求的所有信息。

sentence_examples.en: By using the Command Pattern, you can parameterize objects with operations, queue or log requests, and support undoable actions.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过使用命令模式，可以用操作参数化对象、对请求进行排队或记录，并支持可撤销操作。

sentence_examples.en: A command prompt is a text-based interface where users enter commands to interact with the operating system.
sentence_examples.zh: 命令提示符是用户输入命令与操作系统交互的文本界面。

sentence_examples.en: To open the command prompt in Windows, type 'cmd' in the search bar.
sentence_examples.zh: 在 Windows 中打开命令提示符，请在搜索栏中输入“cmd”。

sentence_examples.en: Command/Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) is an architectural pattern that separates read and write operations for a data store into different models.
sentence_examples.zh: 命令查询职责分离（CQRS）是一种架构模式，将数据存储的读写操作分离为不同的模型。

sentence_examples.en: By applying CQRS, developers can optimize performance and scalability for complex systems with distinct read and write workloads.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过应用CQRS，开发者可以针对读写工作负载明显不同的复杂系统优化性能和可扩展性。

sentence_examples.en: Command/Query Separation is a design principle that states operations should either change state (commands) or return data (queries), but not both.
sentence_examples.zh: 命令查询分离是一种设计原则，规定操作要么改变状态（命令），要么返回数据（查询），但不能同时进行。

sentence_examples.en: By applying Command/Query Separation, developers can reduce side effects and improve code predictability.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过应用命令查询分离原则，开发者能减少副作用并提高代码的可预测性。

sentence_examples.en: Commingled bits refer to data bits that have been combined from multiple sources or streams into a single sequence.
sentence_examples.zh: 混合位指的是来自多个来源或数据流的数据位被合并为单一序列。

sentence_examples.en: The network protocol efficiently handles commingled bits to reduce transmission overhead.
sentence_examples.zh: 该网络协议高效处理混杂比特以减少传输开销。

sentence_examples.en: Communication is the process of exchanging information between entities or groups.
sentence_examples.zh: 通信是实体或群体之间交换信息的过程。

sentence_examples.en: Effective communication is essential for successful collaboration in software development.
sentence_examples.zh: 在软件开发中，有效的交流对于成功协作至关重要。

sentence_examples.en: A community is a group of people who share common interests, goals, or characteristics, often interacting within a specific location or online platform.
sentence_examples.zh: 社区是指拥有共同兴趣、目标或特征的一群人，通常在特定地点或在线平台上互动。

sentence_examples.en: The open-source community collaborates to improve software for public use.
sentence_examples.zh: 开源社区协作改进供公众使用的软件。

sentence_examples.en: A committed transaction is one that has been permanently recorded in the database.
sentence_examples.zh: 已提交的事务是指已永久记录在数据库中的事务。

sentence_examples.en: The developer committed the code changes to the repository before the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者在截止日期前将代码更改提交到了代码库。

sentence_examples.en: Common Intermediate Language is a low-level, platform-agnostic instruction set used by the .NET Framework.
sentence_examples.zh: 公共中间语言是.NET框架使用的一种低级、与平台无关的指令集。

sentence_examples.en: Compilers translate source code into Common Intermediate Language before execution.
sentence_examples.zh: 编译器在执行前会将源代码翻译为公共中间语言。

sentence_examples.en: The Common Language Infrastructure is a standardized open specification developed by Microsoft for executing managed code across different platforms.
sentence_examples.zh: 公共语言基础设施是微软开发的标准化开放规范，用于在不同平台上执行托管代码。

sentence_examples.en: Developers use the Common Language Infrastructure to ensure their applications run consistently on various operating systems.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者使用公共语言基础设施确保其应用程序在不同操作系统上一致运行。

sentence_examples.en: The Common Language Runtime is the virtual machine component of Microsoft's .NET framework that manages the execution of .NET programs.
sentence_examples.zh: 公共语言运行时是微软.NET框架的虚拟机组件，负责管理.NET程序的执行。

sentence_examples.en: Developers rely on the Common Language Runtime to handle memory management, security, and exception handling in their applications.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者依赖公共语言运行时来处理应用程序中的内存管理、安全性和异常处理。

sentence_examples.en: Common Language Specification is a technical term in computer science.
sentence_examples.zh: Common Language Specification 是公共语言规范。

sentence_examples.en: This project uses Common Language Specification in practice.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目在实践中使用了 Common Language Specification。

sentence_examples.en: Common Type System is a technical term in computer science.
sentence_examples.zh: Common Type System 是公共类型系统。

sentence_examples.en: This project uses Common Type System in practice.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目在实践中使用了 Common Type System。

sentence_examples.en: A common name is a non-scientific term used to identify a particular entity in everyday language.
sentence_examples.zh: 通用名是日常语言中用于识别特定实体的非科学术语。

sentence_examples.en: In computing, 'folder' is the common name for a directory in many operating systems.
sentence_examples.zh: 在计算机领域，'文件夹'是许多操作系统中目录的通用名。

sentence_examples.en: Compatibility refers to the ability of different systems, software, or hardware to work together without conflicts.
sentence_examples.zh: 兼容性指不同系统、软件或硬件能够无冲突地协同工作的能力。

sentence_examples.en: The new update ensures backward compatibility with older versions of the application.
sentence_examples.zh: 此次更新确保了与应用程序旧版本的向后兼容性。

sentence_examples.en: The Competing Consumer pattern is a messaging design that allows multiple consumers to process messages from a single queue concurrently.
sentence_examples.zh: 竞争消费者模式是一种消息设计模式，允许多个消费者并发处理来自单一队列的消息。

sentence_examples.en: By implementing the Competing Consumer pattern, the system can scale horizontally to handle increased message throughput.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过实现竞争消费者模式，系统能够水平扩展以处理更高的消息吞吐量。

sentence_examples.en: Compile-time correctness checking is the process by which a compiler verifies that a program adheres to language rules before generating executable code.
sentence_examples.zh: 编译时正确性检查是编译器在生成可执行代码之前验证程序是否遵循语言规则的过程。

sentence_examples.en: Modern IDEs often integrate compile-time correctness checking to highlight errors as developers write code.
sentence_examples.zh: 现代集成开发环境通常集成编译时正确性检查，以便在开发者编写代码时实时标记错误。

sentence_examples.en: Component Object Model is a binary standard for software component interoperability on Microsoft platforms.
sentence_examples.zh: 组件对象模型是微软平台上软件组件互操作的二进制标准。

sentence_examples.en: Developers use Component Object Model to create reusable software components that can interact across different applications.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者使用组件对象模型创建可跨应用程序交互的可重用软件组件。

sentence_examples.en: Composability is the ability of components to be combined and reused in different systems without modification.
sentence_examples.zh: 可组合性指组件能在不同系统中不经修改即可组合和复用的能力。

sentence_examples.en: The framework’s composability allows developers to build complex applications from simple, modular parts.
sentence_examples.zh: 该框架的可组合性使开发者能用简单的模块化组件构建复杂应用。

sentence_examples.en: Composite formatting is a technique that combines a format string with placeholders and variable values to produce formatted output.
sentence_examples.zh: 复合格式化是一种将格式字符串与占位符和变量值结合以生成格式化输出的技术。

sentence_examples.en: Many programming languages use composite formatting to simplify the creation of dynamic strings.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多编程语言使用复合格式化来简化动态字符串的创建。

sentence_examples.en: The Composite Pattern is a structural design pattern that lets you compose objects into tree structures to represent part-whole hierarchies.
sentence_examples.zh: 组合模式是一种结构型设计模式，允许将对象组合成树形结构以表示部分-整体层次。

sentence_examples.en: By using the Composite Pattern, developers can treat individual objects and compositions uniformly.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过使用组合模式，开发者可以统一处理单个对象和组合对象。

sentence_examples.en: Concurrency conflicts occur when multiple processes or threads attempt to access shared resources simultaneously, leading to inconsistent or unexpected results.
sentence_examples.zh: 并发冲突发生在多个进程或线程同时尝试访问共享资源时，导致结果不一致或异常。

sentence_examples.en: To prevent concurrency conflicts, developers use synchronization mechanisms like locks or semaphores.
sentence_examples.zh: 为防止并发冲突，开发者使用锁或信号量等同步机制。

sentence_examples.en: Concurrency mode refers to the operational approach in which multiple computations execute simultaneously within overlapping time periods.
sentence_examples.zh: 并发模式指的是多个计算在重叠时间段内同时执行的操作方式。

sentence_examples.en: The system switched to a different concurrency mode to improve performance under heavy load.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统切换到另一种并发模式以提高重负载下的性能。

sentence_examples.en: Conditional compilation is a feature in programming that allows code to be included or excluded during compilation based on specified conditions.
sentence_examples.zh: 条件编译是编程中的一种功能，允许根据指定条件在编译期间包含或排除代码。

sentence_examples.en: The developer used conditional compilation to create different builds for Windows and Linux platforms.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者使用条件编译为 Windows 和 Linux 平台生成不同的构建版本。

sentence_examples.en: A conditional compilation statement is a directive that instructs the compiler to include or exclude code based on specified conditions.
sentence_examples.zh: 条件编译语句是一种指令，指示编译器根据指定条件包含或排除代码。

sentence_examples.en: Developers use conditional compilation statements to create different builds for various platforms.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者使用条件编译语句为不同平台创建不同的构建版本。

sentence_examples.en: A configuration refers to the arrangement of hardware or software settings that define how a system operates.
sentence_examples.zh: 配置指的是定义系统运行方式的硬件或软件设置的排列。

sentence_examples.en: The network administrator updated the server configuration to improve performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 网络管理员更新了服务器配置以提高性能。

sentence_examples.en: A connection string is a string that specifies information about a data source and the means of connecting to it.
sentence_examples.zh: 连接字符串是指定数据源信息及其连接方式的字符串。

sentence_examples.en: The developer configured the connection string to access the database securely.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发者配置了连接字符串以安全访问数据库。

sentence_examples.en: Consolidate conditional expression is a refactoring technique that combines multiple conditions into a single expression to simplify logic.
sentence_examples.zh: 合并条件表达式是一种重构技术，将多个条件合并为单一表达式以简化逻辑。

sentence_examples.en: By consolidating conditional expressions, the code becomes more readable and easier to maintain.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过合并条件表达式，代码变得更易读且更易维护。

sentence_examples.en: Consolidate Duplicate Conditional Fragments is a refactoring technique that merges identical code blocks appearing in all branches of a conditional statement.
sentence_examples.zh: 合并重复条件片段是一种重构技术，用于合并条件语句所有分支中出现的相同代码块。

sentence_examples.en: By applying Consolidate Duplicate Conditional Fragments, developers can reduce redundancy and improve code maintainability.
sentence_examples.zh: 通过应用合并重复条件片段技术，开发者能减少冗余并提高代码的可维护性。

sentence_examples.en: Consistency in a database ensures that all transactions adhere to predefined rules and maintain data integrity.
sentence_examples.zh: 数据库的一致性确保所有事务遵循预定义规则并维护数据完整性。

sentence_examples.en: The development team strives for consistency in coding standards across all projects.
sentence_examples.zh: 开发团队努力在所有项目中保持编码标准的一致性。

sentence_examples.en: A constructor is a special method used to initialize objects in object-oriented programming.
sentence_examples.zh: 构造函数是面向对象编程中用于初始化对象的特殊方法。

sentence_examples.en: The constructor is called automatically when an object of the class is created.
sentence_examples.zh: 创建类的对象时，构造函数会被自动调用。

sentence_examples.en: A container is a standard unit of software that packages code and all its dependencies so the application runs quickly and reliably from one computing environment to another.
sentence_examples.zh: 容器是一种标准化的软件单元，将代码及其所有依赖项打包，使应用程序能够在不同计算环境中快速可靠地运行。

sentence_examples.en: Docker is a popular platform for developing, shipping, and running applications in containers.
sentence_examples.zh: Docker 是一个流行的平台，用于在容器中开发、部署和运行应用程序。

sentence_examples.en: Container as a Service is a cloud-based service model that allows users to manage and deploy containerized applications without handling the underlying infrastructure.
sentence_examples.zh: 容器即服务是一种基于云的服务模式，允许用户管理和部署容器化应用，而无需处理底层基础设施。

sentence_examples.en: Many enterprises adopt Container as a Service to streamline their application development and deployment workflows.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多企业采用容器即服务来简化其应用程序的开发和部署流程。

sentence_examples.en: Content refers to the information or material contained within a medium, such as text, images, or videos.
sentence_examples.zh: 内容指的是媒介中包含的信息或材料，如文本、图像或视频。

sentence_examples.en: She was content with the results of her hard work.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对自己努力的结果感到满意。
